exposure: Intrathecal fentanyl (25 ug) as an adjuvant to 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine
Intrathecal morphine (100 ug) as an adjuvant to 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine
outcome: Total dose of ephedrine required for hypotension correction
cohort: A cohort of 170 parturients undergoing spinal anesthesia for elective cesarean sections.
finding: The addition of fentanyl as an adjuvant to spinal anesthesia for cesarean section is associated with enhanced hemodynamic stability, lower incidence of vomiting, and reduced ephedrine requirements compared to morphine.
